newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Lightly quoted, mostly steady.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Lightly quoted, mostly steady.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were thinly quoted at steady to higher levels on Thursday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session.
No barges traded versus none on Wednesday.
- 10 barges, St Paul-Savage, upper Mississippi River, two each week of June, bid 130 percent of tariff, unchanged from May 14, no offer.
- 18 barges, St Paul-Savage, upper Mississippi River, two each week of June/July, bid 130 percent, unchanged from May 14, similar, no offer.
- Five barges, Mid-Mississippi, one each week of August, bid 115 percent, no comparison, no offer.
- Four barges, Mid-Mississippi River, one each week of September, bid 155 percent, up five percentage points from May 14, no offer.
